abstract: The National Genomics Data Center (NGDC), as part of the China National Center for Bioinformation (CNCB), provides a family of database resources and web services to both academic and industrial communities worldwide. Given the rapid growth of multi-omics data and the intrinsic dependence of artificial intelligence on high-quality curated data, CNCB-NGDC continues to enhance data integrity, usability, and accessibility, facilitate knowledge discovery, and support data-driven research. Over the past year, CNCB-NGDC has expanded and updated its core database resources and strengthened data exchange and sharing with international collaborators. Thirteen new resources have been released, covering genome and variation (HLA and NMVR), health and disease (PWAS Atlas, CoVAR-KG, HONOR, IBDkb, and MTB-ImmunogenKG), biodiversity and biosynthesis (iCellOmics, iPangolin, SesbaniaOmics, and Vita Taxonomy), and tools (π-OmicsKit and DeepSeMS). All resources and services are publicly accessible at https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn.
